sloka: छायां ते दिनकरभा: प्रबाधमानं वर्षत्रं भरत करोतु मूर्ध्नि शीताम् ।एतेषामहमपि काननद्रुमाणां छायां तामति शयिनीं सुखी श्रयिष्ये ॥ २.१०७.१८॥
transliteration: chāyāṁ te dinakarabhā: prabādhamānaṁ varṣatraṁ bharata karotu mūrdhni śītām ।eteṣāmahamapi kānanadrumāṇāṁ chāyāṁ tāmati śayinīṁ sukhī śrayiṣye ॥ 2.107.18॥

translations.english: Let an umbrella protect you against (scorching) sunshine and provide its cool shade over your head, O Bharata As for me, I shall happily seek the shade of these dense woodland trees.
